name: Geometry: Open World 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Geometry: Open World is a fast-paced 2D action game where players control a ship navigating through treacherous obstacles, battling a variety of enemies, and ultimately facing off against formidable bosses. The game’s dynamic and vibrant open world, combined with strategic upgrades and powerful abilities, allows you to chart your course to victory!
